Canonical, provenance-first vehicle evidence workbook for Expiya Cars MVP.
Each configuration can be uniquely resolved.
Vehicle Identity + Typed Evidence + Equipment + Safety + Fact-level Provenance
Facts do not leak across wrong trims/model years.
No vehicle fact should be treated as VERIFIED without an applicable evidence assertion.
Every material VERIFIED fact answers “How do we know?”
Conflicting sources are preserved; values are not averaged or guessed.
Conflicting sources are preserved without averaging.
LLM may assist extraction/reasoning, but may not invent vehicle specifications.
Material requirements map to available facts.
No arbitrary suitability scores are stored in this dataset.
Collection effort per model is acceptable.
Use as discovery/index seed only. Migration must not auto-promote facts to VERIFIED.
Validate schema with 8 model families before scaling to 50–100 models.
Readable IDs are allocated by repository tooling; existing IDs are immutable.

Do not convert unlisted equipment into NOT_AVAILABLE.
Configuration equipment needs explicit inheritance handling.
